title: Symplectic Error of Implicit Symplectic Integrators: A Qualitative Structural Analysis
summary: We study how inexact nonlinear solvers lead to a loss of exact symplecticity in the Symplectic Euler (SE) and Stormer-Verlet (SV) schemes when applied to general nonseparable Hamiltonian systems. These schemes are implicit and require nonlinear solvers in practice. Here, we consider a fixed number $M$ of fixed-point iterations (FPI). While SE is exactly symplectic under exact solves, a finite $M$ gives only pseudo-symplecticity.
